remarks: Sunrise Hill Townhouse - bright, spacious and full of amenities! Welcome home to this wonderful two bedroom, one-and-a-half bath, three level townhouse located in the highly desirable Sunrise Hill condo complex in Norwalk! Step inside and immediately feel the warmth of natural light filling the bright and inviting living room, complete with gleaming hardwood floors. For your guests or to save steps there is a convenient half bath. The eat-in kitchen features a comfortable dining area and sliders that open to a beautiful deck, perfect for morning coffee or evening gatherings. From the deck, step down to a private enclosed patio- a peaceful outdoor retreat for relaxation or entertaining.Upstairs you have a spacious primary bedroom with walk-in closets, a generous second bedroom and a full bath. the lower level offers a versatile office space along with direct access to your garage. Updates include a new slider out to the deck, new solid oak hardwood floors on second floor, closet inserts and dryer. Exceptional amenities include a pool, playground, tennis and pickleball courts. Ideally located close to shopping, restaurants, major commuting routes and train stations, this home offers the best of convenience and comfort. Enjoy the easy, carefree lifestyle Sunrise Hill has to offer - a true gem in Norwalk.
